summary.en-US: Keep one Firefox network identity consistent: proxy, public IP, approximate location, timezone, and WebRTC.

version.approval_notes: Version 1.1.2 reviewer notes are in docs/AMO-REVIEW.md in the uploaded source archive. The extension is Firefox-only. Proxy passwords stay in storage.session. A fresh install exposes virtual Direct but does not activate it or contact a GeoIP service. Direct routing works before optional GeoIP consent. Schema 3 migrates version-1 and version-2 profiles and stores a non-secret applied route separately from saved edits. A selected proxy never falls back to Direct when unavailable: Firefox receives a terminal proxy list, and the blocking request listener cancels external requests if startup routing cannot be reconstructed safely. Full Firefox restart loses the session password but retains the selected proxy route; traffic remains restricted until credentials are supplied. Proxy errors change health, not route selection. Real Firefox outage and restart tests assert zero direct-origin leaks for HTTP, HTTPS, WS, WSS and proxy DNS, and automatic recovery through the same proxy. GeoIP, geolocation, timezone and WebRTC policies remain independent. Save changes only stored configuration; Apply atomically activates the saved revision. Duplicate never copies passwords. The local coordinate picker sends no tile requests and works offline. The exact signed XPI is published on GitHub only after Mozilla unlisted signing, AMO hash verification and normal Firefox signature verification. This is self-distribution, not public listing approval. No custom update URL is configured; GitHub does not automatically update installations. Existing listed submissions are preserved. Privacy details for 1.1.2 are in docs/PRIVACY.md; no external tile provider is enabled.
